# Story 2 — Browse Movies & Screenings (Story: 2)

## Prerequisites

- Story 1 completed: Customer authentication system (auth guards, auth service, auth interceptor).
- Existing Angular routing infrastructure (`src/app/app.routes.ts`).
- Backend API endpoints available:
  - `GET /api/movies/active`
  - `GET /api/movies/{movieId}`
  - `GET /api/movies/{movieId}/screenings`

---

## Story Goal

Enable customers to browse active movies, view movie details and available screenings, and select a screening for seat reservation. The feature includes proper loading, empty, and error states, groups screenings by calendar day, and filters out past screenings. Movie browsing remains publicly accessible unless the backend requires authentication.

### 2 — Create Movie Service

Create a service to handle all movie and screening API calls:

```typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { Movie, Screening, MovieDetailsResponse, ScreeningListResponse } from '../models/movie.model';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class MovieService {
  private apiUrl = '/api/movies';

  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}

  /**
   * Fetch all active movies
   */
  getActiveMovies(): Observable<Movie[]> {
    return this.http.get<Movie[]>(`${this.apiUrl}/active`);
  }

  /**
   * Fetch details for a single movie
   */
  getMovieDetails(movieId: string): Observable<MovieDetailsResponse> {
    return this.http.get<MovieDetailsResponse>(`${this.apiUrl}/${movieId}`);
  }

  /**
   * Fetch screenings for a specific movie
   */
  getScreenings(movieId: string): Observable<Screening[]> {
    return this.http.get<Screening[]>(`${this.apiUrl}/${movieId}/screenings`);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { takeUntil } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { MovieService } from '../services/movie.service';
import { Movie } from '../models/movie.model';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-movie-list',
  templateUrl: './movie-list.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./movie-list.component.css'],
})
export class MovieListComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  movies: Movie[] = [];
  isLoading = true;
  hasError = false;
  errorMessage = '';

  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();

  constructor(private movieService: MovieService, private router: Router) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.loadMovies();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  loadMovies(): void {
    this.isLoading = true;
    this.hasError = false;
    this.errorMessage = '';

    this.movieService
      .getActiveMovies()
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe({
        next: (movies) => {
          this.movies = movies;
          this.isLoading = false;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.isLoading = false;
          this.hasError = true;
          this.errorMessage = 'Failed to load movies. Please try again.';
          console.error('Error loading movies:', error);
        },
      });
  }

  selectMovie(movieId: string): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/movies', movieId]);
  }

  retry(): void {
    this.loadMovies();
  }
}
```

### 4 — Create Movie Details Component

**File: `src/app/features/movies/movie-details/movie-details.component.ts`** (create new)

Implement the movie details page with screenings:

```typescript
import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { Subject } from 'rxjs';
import { takeUntil } from 'rxjs/operators';
import { MovieService } from '../services/movie.service';
import { Movie, Screening } from '../models/movie.model';

interface GroupedScreening {
  date: string; // formatted date string (e.g., "Monday, August 25")
  screenings: Screening[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-movie-details',
  templateUrl: './movie-details.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./movie-details.component.css'],
})
export class MovieDetailsComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  movie: Movie | null = null;
  groupedScreenings: GroupedScreening[] = [];

  isLoadingMovie = true;
  isLoadingScreenings = true;
  hasMovieError = false;
  hasScreeningsError = false;
  errorMessage = '';

  private destroy$ = new Subject<void>();
  private movieId: string = '';

  constructor(
    private movieService: MovieService,
    private route: ActivatedRoute,
    private router: Router
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.route.params.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe((params) => {
      this.movieId = params['id'];
      if (this.movieId) {
        this.loadMovieDetails();
        this.loadScreenings();
      }
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  private loadMovieDetails(): void {
    this.isLoadingMovie = true;
    this.hasMovieError = false;

    this.movieService
      .getMovieDetails(this.movieId)
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe({
        next: (movie) => {
          this.movie = movie;
          this.isLoadingMovie = false;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.isLoadingMovie = false;
          this.hasMovieError = true;
          this.errorMessage = 'Failed to load movie details. Please try again.';
          console.error('Error loading movie details:', error);
        },
      });
  }

  private loadScreenings(): void {
    this.isLoadingScreenings = true;
    this.hasScreeningsError = false;

    this.movieService
      .getScreenings(this.movieId)
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe({
        next: (screenings) => {
          this.groupedScreenings = this.groupScreeningsByDay(screenings);
          this.isLoadingScreenings = false;
        },
        error: (error) => {
          this.isLoadingScreenings = false;
          this.hasScreeningsError = true;
          this.errorMessage = 'Failed to load screenings. Please try again.';
          console.error('Error loading screenings:', error);
        },
      });
  }

  /**
   * Group screenings by calendar day
   */
  private groupScreeningsByDay(screenings: Screening[]): GroupedScreening[] {
    const now = new Date();
    const filteredScreenings = screenings.filter((s) => new Date(s.startDateTime) > now);

    const grouped: { [key: string]: Screening[] } = {};

    filteredScreenings.forEach((screening) => {
      const screeningDate = new Date(screening.startDateTime);
      const dateKey = screeningDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
        weekday: 'long',
        month: 'long',
        day: 'numeric',
      });

      if (!grouped[dateKey]) {
        grouped[dateKey] = [];
      }
      grouped[dateKey].push(screening);
    });

    // Sort screenings within each day by start time
    Object.keys(grouped).forEach((key) => {
      grouped[key].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.startDateTime).getTime() - new Date(b.startDateTime).getTime());
    });

    // Convert to array and sort by date
    return Object.keys(grouped)
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const dateA = new Date(grouped[a][0].startDateTime);
        const dateB = new Date(grouped[b][0].startDateTime);
        return dateA.getTime() - dateB.getTime();
      })
      .map((date) => ({ date, screenings: grouped[date] }));
  }

  /**
   * Extract time from ISO datetime string
   */
  getScreeningTime(startDateTime: string): string {
    const date = new Date(startDateTime);
    return date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false });
  }

  /**
   * Select a screening and navigate to seat selection
   */
  selectScreening(screeningId: string): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/screenings', screeningId, 'seats']);
  }

  goBack(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/movies']);
  }
}
```

```html
        <div class="skeleton-loader"></div>
        <p>Loading screenings...</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Screenings Error -->
      <div *ngIf="hasScreeningsError && !isLoadingScreenings" class="error-state">
        <p class="error-message">{{ errorMessage }}</p>
        <button (click)="loadScreenings()" class="retry-button">Retry</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Grouped Screenings -->
      <div *ngIf="!isLoadingScreenings && !hasScreeningsError" class="screenings-list">
        <div *ngIf="groupedScreenings.length === 0" class="empty-state">
          <p>No future screenings available.</p>
        </div>

        <div *ngFor="let group of groupedScreenings" class="screening-day-group">
          <h3 class="day-heading">{{ group.date }}</h3>
          <div class="screening-cards">
            <div *ngFor="let screening of group.screenings" class="screening-card" (click)="selectScreening(screening.id)">
              <div class="screening-time">{{ getScreeningTime(screening.startDateTime) }}</div>
              <div class="screening-hall">{{ screening.hall.title }} - {{ screening.hall.type }}</div>
              <div class="screening-price">{{ screening.price }} EGP</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```typescript
import { ComponentFixture, TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { MovieListComponent } from './movie-list.component';
import { MovieService } from '../services/movie.service';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { of, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { Movie } from '../models/movie.model';

describe('MovieListComponent', () => {
  let component: MovieListComponent;
  let fixture: ComponentFixture<MovieListComponent>;
  let movieService: jasmine.SpyObj<MovieService>;
  let router: jasmine.SpyObj<Router>;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const movieServiceSpy = jasmine.createSpyObj('MovieService', ['getActiveMovies']);
    const routerSpy = jasmine.createSpyObj('Router', ['navigate']);

    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      declarations: [MovieListComponent],
      providers: [
        { provide: MovieService, useValue: movieServiceSpy },
        { provide: Router, useValue: routerSpy },
      ],
    }).compileComponents();

    movieService = TestBed.inject(MovieService) as jasmine.SpyObj<MovieService>;
    router = TestBed.inject(Router) as jasmine.SpyObj<Router>;
    fixture = TestBed.createComponent(MovieListComponent);
    component = fixture.componentInstance;
  });

  it('should create', () => {
    expect(component).toBeTruthy();
  });

  describe('loadMovies', () => {
    it('should load active movies and set isLoading to false', () => {
      const mockMovies: Movie[] = [
        {
          id: '1',
          title: 'Movie 1',
          genre: 'Action',
          duration: 120,
          releaseDate: '2026-08-01',
          language: 'English',
          description: 'Test movie',
          isActive: true,
        },
      ];

      movieService.getActiveMovies.and.returnValue(of(mockMovies));
      component.loadMovies();

      expect(component.movies).toEqual(mockMovies);
      expect(component.isLoading).toBeFalse();
      expect(component.hasError).toBeFalse();
    });

    it('should handle error when loading movies fails', () => {
      const error = new Error('API Error');
      movieService.getActiveMovies.and.returnValue(throwError(() => error));
      component.loadMovies();

      expect(component.hasError).toBeTrue();
      expect(component.isLoading).toBeFalse();
      expect(component.errorMessage).toBeTruthy();
    });
  });

  describe('selectMovie', () => {
    it('should navigate to movie details page', () => {
      component.selectMovie('movie-1');
      expect(router.navigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['/movies', 'movie-1']);
    });
  });

  describe('retry', () => {
    it('should reload movies', () => {
      const mockMovies: Movie[] = [];
      movieService.getActiveMovies.and.returnValue(of(mockMovies));
      component.retry();

      expect(component.isLoading).toBeFalse();
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { ComponentFixture, TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { MovieDetailsComponent } from './movie-details.component';
import { MovieService } from '../services/movie.service';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { of, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { Movie, Screening } from '../models/movie.model';

describe('MovieDetailsComponent', () => {
  let component: MovieDetailsComponent;
  let fixture: ComponentFixture<MovieDetailsComponent>;
  let movieService: jasmine.SpyObj<MovieService>;
  let router: jasmine.SpyObj<Router>;
  let activatedRoute: any;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    const movieServiceSpy = jasmine.createSpyObj('MovieService', ['getMovieDetails', 'getScreenings']);
    const routerSpy = jasmine.createSpyObj('Router', ['navigate']);
    const activatedRouteSpy = {
      params: of({ id: 'movie-1' }),
    };

    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      declarations: [MovieDetailsComponent],
      providers: [
        { provide: MovieService, useValue: movieServiceSpy },
        { provide: Router, useValue: routerSpy },
        { provide: ActivatedRoute, useValue: activatedRouteSpy },
      ],
    }).compileComponents();

    movieService = TestBed.inject(MovieService) as jasmine.SpyObj<MovieService>;
    router = TestBed.inject(Router) as jasmine.SpyObj<Router>;
    activatedRoute = TestBed.inject(ActivatedRoute);
    fixture = TestBed.createComponent(MovieDetailsComponent);
    component = fixture.componentInstance;
  });

  it('should create', () => {
    expect(component).toBeTruthy();
  });

  describe('groupScreeningsByDay', () => {
    it('should group screenings by day', () => {
      const futureDate = new Date();
      futureDate.setDate(futureDate.getDate() + 1);
      const screenings: Screening[] = [
        {
          id: 'scr-1',
          startDateTime: futureDate.toISOString(),
          price: 150,
          hall: { id: 'hall-1', title: 'Hall 1', type: 'IMAX' },
        },
      ];

      const grouped = component['groupScreeningsByDay'](screenings);
      expect(grouped.length).toBe(1);
      expect(grouped[0].screenings.length).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should filter out past screenings', () => {
      const pastDate = new Date();
      pastDate.setDate(pastDate.getDate() - 1);
      const futureDate = new Date();
      futureDate.setDate(futureDate.getDate() + 1);

      const screenings: Screening[] = [
        {
          id: 'scr-1',
          startDateTime: pastDate.toISOString(),
          price: 150,
          hall: { id: 'hall-1', title: 'Hall 1', type: 'IMAX' },
        },
        {
          id: 'scr-2',
          startDateTime: futureDate.toISOString(),
          price: 150,
          hall: { id: 'hall-1', title: 'Hall 1', type: 'IMAX' },
        },
      ];

      const grouped = component['groupScreeningsByDay'](screenings);
      expect(grouped[0].screenings.length).toBe(1);
      expect(grouped[0].screenings[0].id).toBe('scr-2');
    });
  });

  describe('selectScreening', () => {
    it('should navigate to seat selection page with screening ID', () => {
      component.selectScreening('screening-1');
      expect(router.navigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['/screenings', 'screening-1', 'seats']);
    });
  });

  describe('goBack', () => {
    it('should navigate back to movies list', () => {
      component.goBack();
      expect(router.navigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['/movies']);
    });
  });
});
```

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Empty movie list (loading succeeds, no movies):** Component displays "No movies are currently available." message. Verified in `MovieListComponent.loadMovies()` and template.

- **API error for active movies:** `hasError` flag set to true, user-friendly message displayed, retry button appears. Tested in `MovieListComponent.loadMovies()` error handler (lines that set `hasError`, `errorMessage`).

- **API error for movie details:** `hasMovieError` flag set independently. User sees error message in the details section. Error handler in `MovieDetailsComponent.loadMovieDetails()` catches and displays error.

- **API error for screenings:** `hasScreeningsError` flag set independently. Movie details still visible; screening section shows error. Error handler in `MovieDetailsComponent.loadScreenings()`.

- **All screenings are in the past:** `groupScreeningsByDay()` filters out past screenings by comparing `new Date(screening.startDateTime) > now`. Result is empty array, "No future screenings available" message displayed.

- **Movie ID does not exist in route:** Component receives movieId from `ActivatedRoute.params` and attempts to fetch. API returns 404 or error. Error handler displays friendly message.

- **Network timeout during load:** Timeout observable triggers error handler; friendly message shown. No raw network error exposed to user.

- **Malformed `startDateTime` in screening:** `new Date(screening.startDateTime)` may result in `Invalid Date`. Component's date formatting uses standard JavaScript Date methods; invalid dates will display as "Invalid Date" in UI. Should be validated by backend; frontend does not add extra validation here.

- **Missing optional fields** (e.g., `posterUrl`, `trailerUrl`, `actors`): Conditional rendering in templates (`*ngIf`) prevents null reference errors. Fields are optional in models, defaults handled in templates with `*ngIf` guards.

- **Very long movie description:** CSS `slice` filter in template limits to 100 characters on list view; full text displayed on details page. CSS on cards uses fixed-width containers; text will wrap naturally.
